params.body:
The first day of mail intake showed two faults:

- **New mail waited behind finished agents.** The limit of three counted every live `mail-*` agent. An agent that is done, or waits for the owner (an approval, an admission, a question), stays in its tab, so after three mails nothing new started: mail:5 waited behind three agents that were done or blocked. Now only agents in state `working` count.
- **A saved attachment stopped the session.** `mail.mjs attachment` saved to `/tmp/mail-<id>/`, outside the session's working directories, and reading it asked for permission (mail-1 waited there). Attachments now go to `~/Projects/.mail/<id>/`, inside `~/Projects`, where mail sessions work.

README updated. `node --check` passes on both scripts.
params.title: Mail intake: count only agents at work, attachments inside ~/Projects
